Use automated diffing tools to compare new package versions with trusted upstreams and detect single-line or minimal changes. Flag packages with names similar to popular libraries (typosquatting/masquerading) and those with sudden, unexplained changes or obfuscated payloads. Monitor outbound network traffic from build and CI/CD environments for connections to untrusted domains, and alert on access to environment variables or credential files during installation or import.
